title: Beta distribution
changes: Installed build information, version history and a previewable feedback template.
Automatic unsigned validation and a manually controlled signed upload workflow.
Sensor reception still requires the foreground. Encrypted GATT and reliable continuous background alarms are unavailable.

title: Health journal and fitness
changes: Notes and optimized photos, blood pressure, weight, administered-insulin records and chosen-duration countdowns.
Equipment catalogue, manual workout records and explicit local JSON export.

title: Alerts and recovery
changes: Opt-in local alerts, alert history and experimental background connection recovery.
Background connection recovery does not provide continuous background glucose monitoring.

title: Sensor replacement
changes: Separate primary and replacement streams, overlap comparison and guarded handover.

title: Dashboard and history
changes: Glucose trends, 2–72-hour graphs, local history and isolated demo data.

title: Bluetooth foundation
changes: Discovery, connection recovery, persistent identity and validated advertisement parsing.
